blocks.text: The BLACK+DECKER 84-Piece Tool Set is a complete kit for almost any home. It includes bits, drivers, wrenches, and the most common hand tools for DIY projects. The cordless electric drill provides the power you need to drill and drive to get the job done. Keep your tool kit handy in the included storage bag for portability and organization. You can trust Black and Decker to deliver the tools you need to make work easy. Make projects fun again with easy-to-use and efficient devices to tackle jobs of all sizes. Home, garden, and yard maintenance have never been this effortless.

items.label: Everything You Need
items.value: Includes a drill, a variety of drill bits and screwdriving bits, pliers, hex wrenches, tape measure, level, hammer, screwdriver, battery, battery charger and bag to help you complete home projects

items.label: Easy To Use Drill
items.value: Easy to use drill with long battery runtime to help you tackle your DIY and home improvement projects

items.label: Stop Stripping and Overdriving Screws
items.value: 11 adjustable clutch settings deliver the right torque setting for whatever project you are working on

items.label: Better Visibility
items.value: Integrated LED lights up your working area

items.label: POWERCONNECT Battery System
items.value: The same interchangeable battery powers your DIY projects with the same 20V MAX battery (Maximum initial battery voltage (measured without a workload) is 20V Nominal votlage is 18)

items.label: Included Components
